definitions.explanation: Happening or changing in small increments over time; not suddenly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{徐々|じょじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
{徐々|じょじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I gradually got better at Japanese.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{徐々|じょじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}て→得る：02014_eru⟧⟦いった→行く：00119_iku⟧。

notes:
{徐々|じょじょ} uses the kanji ⟦{徐|じょ}→徐：noentry⟧ (slow/gradual) repeated.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {徐々|じょじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb (gradually ~)
- {徐々|じょじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ (to change gradually)
- {徐々|じょじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧/⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧ (to gradually increase/decrease)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {徐々|じょじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: gradually (formal, written)
- ⟦だんだん→だんだん：00832_dandan⟧: gradually (casual)
- ⟦{次第|しだい}に→次第に：05531_shidaini⟧: gradually (formal)
- ⟦{少|すこ}しずつ→少しずつ：20047_sukoshizutsu⟧: little by little

USAGE:
- More formal/literary than ⟦だんだん→だんだん：00832_dandan⟧
- Can also be used as a no-adjective: {徐々|じょじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧ (gradual change)
